papers.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
papers.desc: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception.

papers.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
papers.desc: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated).

papers.title: What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
papers.desc: Fine-grained visual understanding requires distinguishing subtle differences in local attributes and spatial relations, yet remains challenging for existing vision-language models.

papers.title: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.desc: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (FF3DGS) reconstructs 3D scenes from images in a single forward pass, making it well-suited to applications that must operate within limited resource budgets.

papers.title: FilmFlow: Agentic System for 3D Virtual Film Cinematography
papers.desc: Complex camera motion is central to visual storytelling, yet translating cinematographic intent into controllable, executable camera trajectories remains challenging.

papers.title: RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation
papers.desc: Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) aims to capture objects and their evolving relationships in videos.

papers.title: RIDAR: Safeguarding Research Integrity in Autonomous Research Agents via Automated Detection and Runtime Intervention
papers.desc: Autonomous research agents are increasingly used to automate large portions of scientific research, yet they are prone to research integrity violations (RIVs): behaviors that compromise the validity, reproducibility, or faithfulness of the research process.

papers.title: What Makes a Good Unmasking Policy? A Controlled Study of Learned Unmasking in Diffusion Language Models
papers.desc: Masked diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but their efficiency depends on which predictions are committed.

papers.title: Who Takes the Lead? Model Ability and Task-Conditioned Collaboration with Humans
papers.desc: As language-model agents grow more capable, they can carry more of a task without asking anyone for help.

papers.title: MambaAct: Efficient Mamba Action Experts for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.desc: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for generalist robotic manipulation, but their inference cost remains a major bottleneck for real-time control.

papers.title: SplatLab: Autonomous Scientific Discovery for 3DGS Research
papers.desc: Reproducing a published 3DGS paper takes weeks of expert engineering before any extension can be proposed.

papers.title: TILDE: Teacher-in-the-Loop Distillation from Embodied Foundation Models
papers.desc: Large-scale action pretraining equips Embodied Foundation Models (EFMs) with strong manipulation capabilities, with particular strengths in generalization and closed-loop robustness, but reproducing such pretraining requires substantial robot data and computation.

papers.title: BrickWright: Agentic Creation of Physically Feasible Brick Builds
papers.desc: Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling.

papers.title: Realism VS Accuracy: Event Sequence Forecasting from a Generative Modeling Perspective
papers.desc: Event sequences are chains of random events, each described by heterogeneous (numerical and categorical) features.

papers.title: HyperDrone: Simulation-to-Reality Transfer at Millions of Frames per Second
papers.desc: We present HyperDrone, an extremely fast quadrotor simulator focused on high-performance batch rendering that is more than 20x faster than existing state-of-the-art batch quadrotor simulators.
